title: spawn_node coordinates: i64 parse silently truncated to i32 — no range check (negative/huge values accepted)
evidence:
+			x, okx := strconv.parse_int(fields[2], 10)
+			y, oky := strconv.parse_int(fields[3], 10)
+			if !okx || !oky {
+				return {}, fmt.tprintf("bad spawn_node position: %s", line)
+			}
+			append(&d.nodes, Node_Spawn{type_name = strings.clone(fields[1]), pos = {i32(x), i32(y)}})
+			// The type name resolves against the catalog at lower time (fail
+			// loud, like an unknown pipe tier); positions are parsed here.
+// lower_nodes — spawn the demo's spawn_node directives into the topology (run
+// setup — NOT the action log; re-created identically on every replay, like the
+// fixture). The type name resolves against the catalog; an unknown type is a
+// demo-authoring error (fail loud, never silent).
detail: strconv.parse_int returns i64; the unchecked i32(x) cast wraps out-of-range values silently (e.g. 3000000000 -> garbage position), and negatives parse fine. A mispositioned node gets blessed into a first-bless golden — contradicting this PR's own fail-loud, never-silent spawn_node stance.
recommended_fix: Range-check both coords before the cast (reject values outside i32 range and non-positive/off-grid positions) with a 'bad spawn_node position' parse error, matching the fail-loud discipline.

title: parse_demo error returns leak cloned spawn_node type_name strings (documented free pairing never runs)
evidence:
+			append(&d.nodes, Node_Spawn{type_name = strings.clone(fields[1]), pos = {i32(x), i32(y)}})
+			if len(fields) < 4 {
+				return {}, fmt.tprintf("bad spawn_node (want: spawn_node <type> <x> <y>): %s", line)
+			}
+// STRING LIFETIME: the Node_Spawn type_name is CLONED with the default
+// allocator (strings.clone) — a raw slice into the temp-allocated demo text
+// Callers free the clones (run_demo's defer / demo_replay_destroy).
detail: Any parse error after a successful spawn_node line returns {} and discards d, leaking the cloned type_name strings plus the new d.nodes slice. The documented pairings (run_demo's defer, demo_replay_destroy) only run on the success path — clone/delete pairing is broken on error exits.
recommended_fix: On parse-error returns, free d.nodes' clones before returning, or parse into a caller-owned arena the caller frees on error.
